sanskrit:
शरीरवाङ्मनोभिर्यत्कर्म प्रारभते नरः ।
न्याय्यं वा विपरीतं वा पञ्चैते तस्य हेतवः ॥ १८-१५॥
iast:
śarīravāṅmanobhiryat karma prārabhate naraḥ
nyāyyaṃ vā viparītaṃ vā pañcaite tasya hetavaḥ 18-15
translation: Whatever action a man performs by his body, speech and mind — whether right, or the reverse — these five are its causes.
